name: Host key hygiene
query: SELECT clearview_url, COUNT(*) FROM devices GROUP BY clearview_url; then normalise lower(), strip scheme, trailing "/" and "www."
decision_rule: Number of raw URLs vs normalised hosts; URLs that collapse. Zac keyed Host NNN on the raw URL (no strip) while flagging the shared host with rstrip("/"); any collapse means his 31/83 count duplicate hosts.

name: Recompute Zac's 31/83/16 and variants
query: Zac cell 25 SQL on (a) raw hosts, (b) normalised hosts, (c) excluding the shared internal host, (d) excluding Unknown machine_type, (e) at reviewed-system level instead of facility account
decision_rule: If (c)+(e) drive both counts toward 0, host = health system and facility accounts explain the overlap.

name: Decompose the multi-host customers
query: For each customer with >1 host: hosts, machines per host, whether one host is the shared host, whether the minority host holds a single machine with a single ticket, whether a multi-account serial is involved
decision_rule: Share explained by shared host / single-ticket strays (serial errors) / transfers / genuinely split fleets.

name: Classify every host
query: Per host: devices, ticketed devices, ticket customers, reviewed systems, states of ticket customers
decision_rule: Classes: no tickets / single customer / single system many customers / multi-system. Device share on single-system hosts = share of fleet with a usable system-level denominator.

name: One host per system?
query: Per reviewed system: distinct non-shared hosts among its ticketed devices; devices on those hosts
decision_rule: If >=90% of systems (and of devices) sit on exactly one host, host can serve as the system key.

name: Unmatched ticket serials
query: Ticket serials absent from devices: count by model, record type, country, account; tolerant re-match (leading zeros, hyphens, prefixes)
decision_rule: Whether the 732 unmatched serials are non-networked models, Canada, retired machines or entry errors.

name: Invisible fleet per host
query: Per host: devices with no ticket in 13 months, device_status mix, transacting months
decision_rule: Shows how far ticket-derived customer fleets understate installed fleets.

name: Host-level exposure (optional, heavy)
query: Per host and month: distinct transacting devices from transaction_events
decision_rule: System-level denominators (active machine-months) for hosts that pass D4/D5.
